note: Two layouts are supported. Flat: 'Name.ffx' + 'Name.png' in this folder. Folder: a sub-folder 'Name/' holding the .ffx (or .ghostffx), a preview image (.png/.jpg) and an optional preview video (.mp4/.webm). Both show up automatically in the FFX Presets section — no code change needed. Entries below are optional and only override the display name, tags and sample text.
